issue_request: FHIR-14208 was a Published FHIR-core MnM STU3 change request, resolved Persuasive with Modification, asking for human-friendly syntax/examples for date, dateTime, and timestamp. The accepted resolution called for usage-note examples for date, dateTime, instant, and time.
initial_application: The Jira comment reports an SVN application revision, and git history shows the explicit implementation as 97b8292e52d8616ee9d0386b5c68b80d7982475a, '#14208 - improve doco on data types', which changed source/datatypes.html on 2017-12-13 to add date/dateTime/instant examples and a human-readable time format.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini routes datatype pages through datatypes.html, confirming the inspected source is build-facing. Later datatype wording edits preserved the date/dateTime/instant examples and time hh:mm:ss format while modernizing timezone language to UTC offset wording. Zulip and Confluence searches found only bot/generated issue references or unrelated numeric hits, with no discovered community decision changing the published Jira/source conclusion.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The combined branch already states date as YYYY, YYYY-MM, or YYYY-MM-DD with examples; dateTime as YYYY, YYYY-MM, YYYY-MM-DD, or YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss+zz:zz with examples; instant as YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss.sss+zz:zz with examples; and time as hh:mm:ss. The missing literal time example 15:24:00 is redundant with the explicit format and does not warrant a source edit.
